acceptance: A current MCP run with compression off on a platform with no registered defaults compares with a matching CLI run (test with real bundles produced by both entry points at SF 0.01).
Pre-parity MCP bundles are still refused with exit 4 and the same reason text.

If a field is added to the bundle, the bundle schema version is bumped, quality/result-bundle.schema.json is regenerated from the validator source, and bundles without the field still validate and load.
context:
Decision gate: Choose between a new explicit capture marker in the bundle and a rule derived from fields already recorded (for example the BenchBox version that produced it). Prefer no format change if an existing field separates pre- and post-parity bundles reliably; record the evidence.

Item guardrails: Bundle format changes follow the schema version and generated JSON Schema published in PR #4274; no hand-edited schema; old bundles keep loading; do not edit published bundles.

Verification rubric: Pass = all three acceptance points shown by tests. Fail = any current bundle refused or any pre-parity bundle accepted.

Base guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; one PR per repository; no live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, servers) only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status; never start deliberate CPU, memory or disk load, and tests inject readings instead; comment policy (make comment-policy-check); changelog.d fragment for user-facing change. Re-verify every cited file and line on current develop before acting; they are hints and drift. Stop and report instead of widening scope; scope removed during review is re-homed to a named item or dropped by the owner with a reason.

Origin: Heuristic limit recorded at closeout of mcp-bundles-before-parity-fix-not-comparable-20261114 (PR #4273).
description:
Problem: PR #4273 makes compare refuse (exit 4) a pair where one side is an MCP bundle with no recorded config.compression or config.platform_options. A post-fix MCP run with compression disabled on a platform with no registered defaults records neither, so it is refused as not comparable.

Outcome: bundles record an explicit capture version or marker so compare tells pre-parity bundles from current ones without inference.
